description: This Java class 'StoreFilter' functions as a web request interceptor in a Spring-based eCommerce application. It handles tasks such as setting up merchant store data, user session attributes, localization, breadcrumbs, and caching of content, categories, and configurations during the request lifecycle.

classes.name: StoreFilter
classes.description: Spring MVC interceptor that initializes session, localization, breadcrumb, cache, and configuration data for each web request in a multi-store eCommerce setup.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Main entry point for request interception; manages session attributes, localization, cache loading, breadcrumb setup, and content initialization.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreInSession
methods.description: Sets the merchant store in session based on store code parameter.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Loads merchant-specific configurations into request scope, utilizing cache if enabled.

methods.name: getContentPageNames
methods.description: Fetches content page descriptions for navigation and CMS links, with caching logic.

methods.name: getContentObjects
methods.description: Retrieves content objects for the page (like boxes and sections) with caching support.

methods.name: getTopCategories
methods.description: Fetches top-level categories for the store, supports caching.

methods.name: getContentPagesNames
methods.description: Loads page name descriptions for footer or other CMS links, with cache.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads content entities like boxes and sections from database or cache.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Loads category list data, respecting locale and cache.

methods.name: getConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves merchant configurations from database and maps to key-value pairs.

methods.name: setBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds breadcrumb navigation trail based on current page context.

methods.name: getDefaultBreadcrumbItem
methods.description: Provides default breadcrumb item for home page.
